door_rules._doc: A door is always in a wall (topology/door_rules.py): walls are completed along each door's line up to the next crossing wall, and missing-room hypotheses that close a room with a door become walls. Added walls are NEEDS_REVIEW. A window no wall hosts that stands between two walls (within window_side_gap_m on each side) is hosted in the wall of its line, extended across it.

label_rules._doc: Room names need rooms (topology/label_rules.py): a room holding several names of different kinds misses a wall between them, and a room name outside every room needs a room; the missing-room hypothesis that separates / encloses the names becomes a wall (NEEDS_REVIEW). Names of open_plan_types may share one room. Off in approach 1 (hypotheses stay proposals there); approach 2 switches it on.
